best_match.fbbt_definition: Odorant receptor neuron (ORN) whose dendrite transduces signals from a maxillary palp basiconic sensillum. The axons of these neurons fasciculate in the labial nerve and the antenno-subesophageal tract (AST) and innervate the antennal lobe.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00007353 'maxillary palp olfactory receptor neuron', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
